title: MMA game in Godot using claude and meshy
author: No_Age4655
selftext:
Tried my hand at making an MMA game in Godot using Opus 5.5, been prompting for the last 3 weeks

Thoughts?

Made and downloaded models from meshy, I notice some of the movements are way off and weird looking.  No matter what i prompt it stays the same so I figure its a dead end

comments.author: Blake9712
comments.body: I’d say trial and error and you can get it perfect. I’d love a new pc combat sports game (undisputed is garbage and the ufc games aren’t on pc) you’re three weeks in, that’s nothing. And it looks fun. I bet you can make it perfect if you keep at it. Most decent ai games take like a year or so after all.

replies.author: No_Age4655
replies.body: Thanks man i appreciate that , , I figure I'll keep at it and see how far I can get it, my key focus is on ragdoll animations and knockouts being unique each time, but it they ended uo looking quite flimsy

comments.author: Original-League-6094
comments.body: Better knockout animation than EA UFC already.

comments.author: askdoobie
comments.body: Nice but fuck meshy man you know what I mean

replies.author: No_Age4655
replies.body: I dont think I'm clued up lol, whats wrong with meshy?

comments.author: ScaredFlamingo6807
comments.body: This is my workflow too! Sick man. I love where you’ve gotten

replies.author: No_Age4655
replies.body: Thanks!, so far I think combat games are quite difficult to get right in AI, maybe with newer models it will become better. Would love to check your boxing game out :)

comments.author: SouthCentralMenace
comments.body: This gives me hope. For my next project, Im hoping to generate an AKI style wrestling game engine.

comments.author: AgitAngst
comments.body: Before updating the game, ask Claude to write you a video and screenshot tool.
